title: Databricks ConcurrentAppendException on partitioned table with WriteSerializable but not Serializable
question:
Take the following table:

CREATE TABLE sales_data (
    sale_id STRING,
    customer_id STRING,
    amount DOUBLE,
    sale_date DATE,
    region STRING
)
USING DELTA
PARTITIONED BY (region)
LOCATION 'dbfs:/mnt/datalake/sales_data';

When I am trying to write to the following table using:

new_data = [
    ("S1001", "C2001", 99.99, "2025-08-10", "East"),
    ("S1002", "C2002", 149.49, "2025-08-10", "West")
]

columns = ["sale_id", "customer_id", "amount", "sale_date", "region"]

df = spark.createDataFrame(new_data, columns)

df.write \
  .format("delta") \
  .mode("append") \
  .saveAsTable("sales_data")

I get an error like delta.exceptions.ConcucurrentAppendException.

Now the writes happen very fast, like multiple writers are writing to the same table in millisecond time, and the region is unique for each write, ie. will always write to a different partition.

I solved the problem by using delta.isolationLevel = Serializable.

But my questions are:

  • Default isolation is WriteSerializable, so this should not happen, all writes will occur as if they are happening one after another. So Serializable should not be an issue here. Right?
  • If the region or partition key is unique on each write then this should not happen. That is each write is on a different partition.

Can someone explain this behavior ? Has anyone experienced something similar ?

Databricks Runtime: 15
answer:
I agree that the behavior you're describing shouldn't be possible...

From the documentation on ConcucurrentAppendException:

Important: Blind appends can conflict in WriteSerializable mode if multiple concurrent transactions running DELETE, UPDATE, or MERGE operations might reference values inserted by blind appends.

Is there a possibility that some delete, update, or merge operation could be happening during the blind append operations you're running?
